On dark-region chroma specifically — the reviewer's own metric — case_089 measures mean Lab C* 2.47 for pixels with L*<35, against a deep_jewel group median of 2.38: slightly ABOVE median, rank 25/43. The dark-region mean RGB ~(20,18,19) the reviewer cited is what deep_jewel looks like group-wide on this rig, not a case-specific failure.

3. The chroma metric is confounded by framing, not palette compliance. case_088 — the same broken_dry + deep_jewel + broad_blended_plane item, differing only in accent light (controlled_rim vs reflected_color) — has the HIGHEST saturation in the deep_jewel group (0.2082) purely because it is a tight face close-up dominated by skin; its garment is likewise dark neutral slate. Saturation here tracks how much skin is in frame.

4. Jewel hue IS present, just low-amplitude. Under gamma lift (0.45) plus 3x saturation boost, the garment resolves to a coherent jewel-family hue — deep indigo/sapphire in seed 1001, deep teal in seed 3003 — consistent across the garment planes rather than random noise. It reads black at normal exposure because the value is very low, not because hue is absent.

5. The item's own prompt prescribes this: "filled with deep jewel color separated by dark neutrals and small high-value accents" (catalog/linework_coloring.yaml:3876-3897). A low-key dark-neutral garment with restrained hue and reflected-color accents on the folds is the specified rendering.

6. broken_dry IS evident at full resolution, contradicting the second half of the hold. Seed 2002 is the lightest of the three and makes the linework legible: the waistband line breaks into discontinuous dashes, the pocket outline is a thin stroke that fades to nothing at both corners, the hem is interrupted, and the sleeve contour drops out in several places — classic dry-brush skip. A direct A/B against case_269 (selective_edge with identical coloring/shading/accent factors) shows continuous, unbroken shape boundaries by contrast. The thumbnail read "smooth and painterly" because at contact-sheet scale the near-black garment collapses line-vs-fill contrast to nothing.

Minor note, not a hold: seed 2002 is the least colored of the three (0.116, near-greyscale) and is a visible seed outlier within the case, but it still sits above the deep_jewel group minimum (0.1107) and far above the 0.5-deviation threshold; comparable seed spread occurs throughout the group.

- Shoulder/upper sleeve: a continuous thin dark outline against the grey ground, heaviest at the shoulder crest and attenuating down the arm.
- Cuff/wrist crop of P7000625: the sleeve edge carries a distinct dark ink line that thickens at the cuff fold and tapers to nothing where it meets the hand; finger contours are drawn with the same fine tapered stroke.

So all three catalog factors are confirmed, not just two: fine_tapered (above), skin_centered_neutral (ivory top, taupe skirt, warm neutral skin, no chromatic accent), soft_two_band (a single soft light/shadow band across the top and sleeves with a diffuse transition edge).
